_comment: The merchant master. Every merchant the pipeline recognises has one entry keyed by its canonical name; every spelling seen in the source is listed under 'aliases'. A cleaned name matching neither a key nor an alias is unrecognised and goes to the merchant_review sheet -- it is never guessed. 'mcc' is an optional human assertion that outranks every automated MCC signal.

AMAZON MARKETPLACE.note: kept separate from AWS CLOUD SERVICES

AMERICAN UNIVERSITY.note: geography dropped, as elsewhere; MERCHANT_COUNTRY carries it

APPLE STORE.note: bare APPLE folded here on MCC evidence: its rows are 5732/5812, never the 4899 that marks APPLE MUSIC

AUB PAYROLL.note: employer, not an internal movement: every row is SALARY_CREDIT or BONUS_CREDIT with zero purchases, which is what separates these from the descriptors they resemble. No curated MCC -- the source codes them 6012, which the workbook's MCC reference does not define

AWS CLOUD SERVICES.note: kept separate from AMAZON MARKETPLACE: same parent, different business (7372 vs 5999). MCC describes what was sold, not who owns the brand

EMIRATES AIRLINE.note: bare EMIRATES is 4511 in AE, which is this and not either of the two 6011 Emirates ATMs

EMIRATES ISLAMIC ATM.note: EMIRATES IA read as Islamic ATM; both are 6011 in AE so MCC cannot separate it from EMIRATES NBD ATM - the letter pattern does

EMIRATES NBD ATM.note: EMIRATES NA read as NBD ATM; see EMIRATES ISLAMIC ATM

LEILA RESTAURANT.note: see LEILA MINI MARKET - do not merge

MARHABA MARKET.note: see MARHABA TRADING - do not merge

MARHABA TRADING.note: kept apart from MARHABA MARKET: 5300 wholesale against 5411 grocery, so the shared first word is not evidence of one merchant

MEZYAN.note: restaurant (5812). Distinct merchant from MEZYANE (5691 clothing) despite the one-letter difference

MICROSOFT365.note: kept separate from MICROSOFT - a named product line, not a spelling variant

MIDDLE EAST AIRLINES.note: no curated MCC: 4511 on its ticket sales and 6012 on the salary credits it pays, and one assertion would overwrite the other

SPINNEYS EXPRESS.note: kept separate from SPINNEYS - distinct store format, not a spelling variant

TOTAL LEBANON.note: region suffix kept: TOTAL alone would collide with TOTAL WINE and TOTAL FITNESS CTR, which are unrelated merchants

UBER TRIP.note: bare UBER is 4121, which is the ride and not UBER EATS at 4215

VIRGIN MEGASTORE.note: VIRGIN M is 5942 (books/media) so it folds here, not into VIRGIN MOBILE (4814)

WAITROSE.note: WTRS is Waitrose (5411 grocery, GB), NOT Waterstones (5942 books) - the two vowel-dropped forms look alike and are different merchants
